title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-17
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Beyer M160 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording captures a solid show with standout Shakedown Street, Spanish jam and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape immerses the listener in the 1982 performance, delivering clear crowd ambience that puts you there. The set shines on Shakedown Street, an expansive Spanish jam and a heartfelt Wharf Rat, making it a worthwhile download despite being only an audience capture.

ai_rating.rationale: Single positive 4‑star review highlights strong performance and enjoyable audience recording; limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised for its immersive ambience; no major clarity or dropout issues mentioned, though reviewer notes a preference for soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic set with strong groove; Spanish jam provides a smooth transition and the show closes on an emotive Wharf Rat.
